title: Development and Validation of an Artificial Intelligence-Based Assistance System for Function-Preserving Minimally-Invasive Rectal Cancer Surgery
summary: The study aims to investigate how accurately AI methods can provide assistance during robot-assisted rectal surgery. To this end, routine data from patient care and surgery will be analyzed in anonymized form.
conditions: Rectal cancer; function-preserving minimally invasive rectal resection with total mesorectal excision (TME)

interventions.name:
This is a non-interventional observational study.
Retrospective and prospective data from routine clinical practice will be analyzed for patients who have undergone robot-assisted rectal resection in the past.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Retrospective:
Robot-assisted rectal resections performed at a participating center
Prospective:
Indication for robot-assisted rectal resection using a surgical robot (e.g., the DaVinci system)
Patient understands German
Exclusion criteria:
Conversion to open surgery
Technical difficulties with data collection or data loss
Missing or incomplete surgical videos
